What degraded

  • Shipped at the round cap, 7.124, 0.576 under the 7.7 rung. The craft floor stood down with the art median at 6.5.
  • The flow critic's reorder (frames 7 and 8 ahead of the turn) was declined, and every judge then named the sag after the turn.
  • Frame 5 was not recomposed at a standing eye, the fix all three round 3 judges named.
  • Three looser phrasings named by round 3's integrity judge were left, because past the cap only a hard fail is repaired. The caption's first line still places the no-show entry at UTHealth Houston, frame 5 draws a cumulative count and an annual projection at one scale without naming either period, and frame 6's 'the other eleven describe the work' sits beside the stillbirth pilot's stated 88 percent accuracy.

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it 12 of 120. The UT System's health AI pilots, paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

At UTHealth Houston, a no-show project's entry states what it saved.

The UT System's page credits it with saving more than 6,500 appointments and $900,000 in revenue. The page cites no audit behind it. The page projects at least 15,000 a year at UT Health San Antonio, where it is set to expand.

The project is one of 12 pilots UT REAL Health AI funded out of 120 systemwide submissions. A UT San Antonio pilot puts an AI assistant called Leah into emergency triage at seven UT hospital sites. UTMB Galveston is deploying referral triage. A Dell Medical School pilot will read clinical notes across more than 7 million patient records for signs of suicide risk.

Of the 12 entries, only the no-show entry states what it already saved.

UT REAL Health AI holds its symposium in Austin on October 7th and 8th. Will a second pilot bring a count of its own?

#UTHealthHouston #UTREALHealthAI #UTSystem

    Named on no. 42's frame 9.

    44 of this week's 45 frames had no size floor.

Notes

The record. Re-verified 82 items on the diff and 21 on fetched primary sources. tx-2026-0112 moved: the PUCT's final order in docket 59315 was re-read and rehearing motions filed on September 22nd were added. Boundary blocks were written for tx-2026-0041 and tx-2026-0055 and tx-2026-0046 was re-measured. Admitted tx-2026-0201 (UT REAL Health AI's 12 pilot projects, today's deck) and tx-2026-0202 (ERCOT's energization pause). Held a UT Austin item whose source answered 403. Discovery found nothing actionable on the Federal Register or the PUCT. All eleven instrument checks exited 0. The deck. Panel medians 6.93, 7.014 and 7.124 over three rounds of three judges, no hard fail in any round. Through the panel the deck stopped calling the no-show figure the project's own count and now says the page cites no audit behind it, on every surface and in the record. Two claim quotes were extended from a re-read of the page, slide 9's unsourced line was replaced by the symposium's registration link, and the stipple on the screens and panes was traced to a near plane of 0.05 m and fixed. Did this run wait on a human. The final prompt audit measured 1,393 tool calls with 458 over its threshold, the longest 36.1 seconds, none a permission dialog. This is the queued prompt-audit-reads-auto-mode-as-human defect, now at repeat 1. No-stall hook: armed at 06:22:16 UTC, judged the session unattended from SessionStart with the host's CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED=0, and refused nothing. The session's worker process was restarted once mid-run and the run resumed from its branch.

This is a draft. Nothing was sent. The deck is already merged to main, so these links are live. Posting is the only step left, and it is yours.
